base_control_instruction.base_procedure: Bind obligations to source edition, citation, effective period, entity role and boundary; classify direct, delegated, conditional and enforcement context; check amendments and judicial status quarterly and at legal events.
base_control_instruction.base_test: For independently selected occurrences, walk the authored procedure in order and trace each action to dated, scoped records. Inspect these control-specific outputs: Source hash; applicability rationale; legal-status check; reviewer decision. Reperform the recorded decision or reconciliation and inspect a failure/exception path. Resolve exact source-level acceptance criteria before using this proposed test.
base_control_instruction.boundary_rule: Corporate execution requires a documented responsibility split and evidence that it covers the site/system; retain local complementary measures.
base_control_instruction.failure_response: Record failed, missing and untested steps separately, preserve original evidence, assign remediation and independently retest. A later pass does not repair an earlier period.
base_control_instruction.population_rule: Reconcile independent source records to all occurrences in the accepted period and boundary before risk-based selection. Record query, exclusions and selection rationale; no invented sample size.

input_contract: Actual retained artifact bytes, original SHA and normal receipt metadata; cached document ignored
Trusted original/intake route maps must match actual native system; one company/branch and one registry scope
Company methods only rederive arbitrary registered channels and complete selected calendar-month windows; no expected fixture count or branch parameter
Native full custody references and locator-only business references have distinct explicit join bases; unavailable/missing originals remain unresolved
next_gate: Independent exact-module method review before any actual source fieldwork; root integrates separately
output_contract: No task mutation, status credit, PASS/N/A, final legal conclusion or enterprise no-event assertion
Selected export/original roster agreement is distinct from original attachment preservation, source-link resolution and physical period continuity
A company configuration may claim whole selected period continuity; original communication-system operation is not independently established by these methods

selected_tasks.authored_instruction: For independently selected occurrences, walk the authored procedure in order and trace each action to dated, scoped records. Inspect these control-specific outputs: Source hash; applicability rationale; legal-status check; reviewer decision. Reperform the recorded decision or reconciliation and inspect a failure/exception path. Resolve exact source-level acceptance criteria before using this proposed test.
proposed_performed_facets: Retained company/native version/hash/event/publication/import custody bound to ordinary collection receipt and exact artifact bytes
Selected registry and operating channel configuration; declared full-month vector and explicit startup/unregistered exclusions
Fixed typed channel/received-time/available-time count reconciliation against collected originals; stored SQL never executed
Contemporaneous ledger/screen/tail/quarter versions and later corrections reconciled without overwriting historical missing channels or OPEN exception
Recorded classifier source links and retained exception/reviewer decisions inspected as documentary company judgments
unperformed_facets: Authoritative law edition, source citation, effective-period/entity-role obligation applicability and full boundary responsibility split
Direct/delegated/conditional/enforcement obligation classification and amendments/judicial-status/legal-event sufficiency
Underlying original communication-system SQL execution, enterprise source completeness and external legal/professional acceptance

selected_tasks.activation: On an actual legal event or scheduled source-context review; no enforcement matter is asserted.
selected_tasks.authored_instruction: Classify as triggered legal-response context and link the response playbook.
proposed_performed_facets: Recorded counsel classification joined to contemporaneously available original
Contemporaneously available response playbook source is visible separately; explicit case-to-playbook linkage is not inferred
unperformed_facets: Actual facts and qualified applicability/design decision; no enforcement or external assistance matter asserted
Any missing explicit context/playbook or legal source acceptance remains a limitation

selected_tasks.activation: On an actual legal event or scheduled source-context review; no enforcement matter is asserted.
selected_tasks.authored_instruction: Retain correspondence and distinguish assistance from an approval or assurance conclusion.
proposed_performed_facets: Retained original message text, source receipt/hash and exact native attachment links
Recorded counsel context distinguished from independent approval/assurance; actual_external_message false remains explicit
unperformed_facets: Actual facts and qualified applicability/design decision; no enforcement or external assistance matter asserted
Any missing explicit context/playbook or legal source acceptance remains a limitation
